en: Colorized historic view of a church with a tall, steep green roof and side turrets, identified as the Trinity Church. It stands beside residential-style buildings with red roofs along a tree-lined street bordered by stone walls and iron gates. The sky is softly tinted blue with light clouds, typical of early 20th‑century chromolithographic postcards. Printed caption text appears at the top.
